snippet.title: Barty's Adventure Summer 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Barty's Adventure is a cozy, time-loop metroidvania set in the world of children's toys. Think of it as Toy Story meets Majora's Mask! 

Wishlist the game now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205260/Bartys_Adventure/

Join our Discord Community!
